challenge.method: Tested for confusion with MPL 1.0 and with the Mozilla component of NPL 1.1. Checked §§1.0.1, 8, and 13, the document opening, the exhibits, and the digest selected by the Index.
challenge.results: The Commercial Use definition, §§8.1–8.4, and §13 distinguish version 1.1 from 1.0. This plaintext opens with the Mozilla heading and ends with the Mozilla exhibit. The combined NPL reference opens with amendments and includes an additional Netscape exhibit.

limitations: The finding applies to the pinned standalone Mozilla plaintext. The embedded Mozilla heading in the combined NPL 1.1 document also identifies its base text.
The HTTP URL difference concerns SPDX’s licenseText field. Its standardLicenseHeader uses HTTPS.
reasoning: Mozilla’s plaintext names Mozilla Public License Version 1.1 at the beginning and in Exhibit A. Its §13 names the MPL. The Index decision binds the exact publisher digest and entity to the proposed historical classification upon qualification.
